name: A-B regular solution
_source: Synthetic symmetric regular solution for validating miscibility gap handling: one solution phase with ideal end members (G = 0) and a single Redlich-Kister parameter L0 = 20000 J/mol, so the gap is symmetric about x = 0.5 with critical temperature Tc = L0 / (2R) = 1202.73 K and binodal ln(x/(1-x)) = L0(2x-1)/(RT).
